summary_1line: Bhishma explains that righteous warfare, protection of subjects, and heroic death in battle grant Kshatriyas merit and heavenly reward, likening battle to a vast sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: A lone armored warrior stands amid a chaotic battlefield of elephants, chariots, and flying arrows, refusing to turn his back while enemies close in.
A gruesome river of blood flows across the battlefield, filled with broken weapons, shields, and fallen warriors while vultures circle overhead.
King Amvarisha in heaven watches his radiant general Sudeva ascending in a celestial chariot beside Indra.
